milestones.outcome: Prioritized candidate sources compile in frozen image, failed-frame cause isolated, independent reference/source/inputs/commands/resources/unique outputs ready. Freeze performance workload and task eval definitions; run evaluation harness smoke or estimate runtime from existing exact-stack valid evidence.
milestones.evidence: Actual build and preflight receipts, immutable READY descriptors, runnable dense/candidate/task commands and measured/explicitly uncertain runtime estimate.
milestones.if_missed: Flag missing executable dependencies; fix precise input/build/adapter defects without relabeling paper invalid; narrow active breadth to finish one real candidate.

milestones.outcome: At least one candidate passes applicable NPU numeric/state/graph gate and enters valid whole-model smoke with actual worker/operator dispatch.
milestones.evidence: Independent NPU verdict plus service logs and request result; CPU-only and synthetic examples do not satisfy.
milestones.if_missed: Notify major schedule risk now, name exact cause and remaining work; promote genuinely READY alternative. Do not rerun identical failure or silently extend.

milestones.outcome: One valid same-config dense/candidate whole-model paired performance screen with fixed1024 output and TTFT/TPOT; task smoke GSM8K/HumanEval/MMLU.
milestones.evidence: Raw requests, exact workload and source identities, output lengths, timing metrics, independent paired comparison and smoke answers.
milestones.if_missed: No formal performance claim. Implement only evidence-backed critical-path repair; if no valid model path, report risk instead of spending all time on lower-level gates.

milestones.outcome: Promising candidate completes three formal paired performance rounds; compose techniques only when interactions independently qualify. Full task evaluation started with measured projected finish.
milestones.evidence: All3 raw pairs, same commonopts/baseline and no profiler; task job identity/progress and measured ETA.
milestones.if_missed: Freeze best validated implementation, eliminate extra variants, reserve sufficient full evaluation time; results below10% remain unmet even if numerics pass.

milestones.outcome: Full GSM8K/HumanEval/MMLU paired or provenance-matched frozen-baseline results available; report absolute and relative loss, failures, EOS/length stats; portability/opt-in/rollback smoke.
milestones.evidence: Task definitions, raw outputs/scorers/configuration and checkpoint hashes; measured precision loss not tensor tolerances.
milestones.if_missed: Do not promote smoke to full. Use remaining time only to finish highest-value missing acceptance evidence; warn if deadline not feasible.

milestones.outcome: Deliver qualified plugin plus reproducible proof, or exact unmet requirements and scoped technical findings. Source/provenance/tests/commands/logs/handoff in coherent committed remote branch.
milestones.evidence: Final requirement-by-requirement audit, normal push acknowledgement; no main/force push.
milestones.if_missed: Stop new loads at fixed deadline, preserve output and clean up only owned jobs. No automatic authority renewal.

simulation.next: Repair exact mismatch and cold same-image check; leave original run; schedule another READY task. Do not infer algorithm failure.

simulation.classification: current implementation incorrect or backend incompatibility
simulation.next: Localize first divergence against independent oracle; one new mechanism-specific repair with preserved failing case; do not relax gate.

simulation.classification: current memory/runtime integration unsupported under current resource margin
simulation.next: Measure explicit vs runtime allocations; test vectorized packing node reduction; no arbitrary safety-reserve reduction or batch16-only padding without correctness proof.

simulation.scenario: KIVI inactive atomic error flags / vector timeout
simulation.classification: real device behavior inconsistent with intended inactive path; precise root not yet fully proven
simulation.next: Test value-masked atomic rewrite and legal/illegal active branches; retain original timeout, partial observations and report-consumer failure separately.

simulation.scenario: MXR inversion remains outside FP64 numeric gate
simulation.next: Require new-compiled control bitwise match then compensate intermediate precision; save all outputs before rejection; no conclusion that all MXR methods fail.
Use measured end-to-end critical path; at most justified bounded tuning/composition of already-qualified mechanisms. No adding kernel speedups or performance percentages.

simulation.scenario: Throughput passes but task accuracy exceeds tolerance
simulation.next: Tune documented algorithm strength or revert offending part, then rerun paired relevant gates and affected task tests; do not cherry-pick easier samples.

simulation.scenario: No READY job while card idle
simulation.next: MAIN fixes closest executable blocker; agents prepare next-stage executables before completion; record gap as unknown unless continuous evidence; never dummy load.

simulation.classification: parallel eligible only with verified disjoint scope
simulation.next: Disjoint physical4-7 mapping and summed host resources, separate outputs/controllers; TP4/model performance exclusive. An old all4-idle controller is not declared compatible by label.

simulation.scenario: Task evaluation time exceeds remaining window
simulation.next: Use measured smoke ETA early and freeze candidate; notify early. Never substitute smoke or smaller task dataset for requested full evaluation.
